The Indian food processing industry accounts for 32% of the country's total food market, one of the largest industries in India and is ranked fifth in terms of production, consumption, export and expected growth.

Total revenue of FMCG market is expected to grow at a CAGR of 27.9% through 2021 to 2027, reaching nearly US$ 615.87 billion.CRISIL forecasts 7 -9% revenue growth for the FMCG sector in the current FY25, driven by increased volume and rural demand recovery.
Growth & demand: 18483.36 Lacs in the previous year with growth rate of 12% and CAGR (5 years) of 18% For the financial year 2024-2025, the Company achieved Profit before tax of Rs.
26,49,103 crore (US$ 307 billion) in 2023, driven by growing demand for processed products, according to industry body P HD Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PHDCCI).
The food processing sector has grown substantially, averaging an annual growth rate of around 7.3%, during 2015-2022.
